test_empty_episode_info: test that an empty EpisodeInfo has default start 0, num_steps 0, and None metadata
test_episode_info_init_with_kwargs: test EpisodeInfo initialization with random start, num_steps, and storage_pb2 metadata values
create_episode_info_empty: create an empty EpisodeInfo object with default start, num_steps, and metadata values
